title: Submit Before You Resist
headline: How to Resist Temptation: Submit to God First
headline_sub: Spiritual Warfare Begins With a Yes
tagline: Spiritual warfare begins with a YES before it becomes a NO.
seo_title: How to Resist Temptation: Submit First (James 4:7) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Spiritual warfare doesn't begin with your no to Satan; it begins with your yes to God. A devotional for men on James 4:7 and walking by the Spirit.
verse_text: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

scriptures.text: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

items: We talk frequently about resistance.
Resist temptation.
Resist lust.
Resist fear.
Resist bitterness.
Resist the devil.
And all of that matters.
But James gives us an order that we cannot afford to reverse.
He doesn’t merely say, “Resist the devil.”
He says, “Submit yourselves to God.” Then, “Resist the devil.”
That order matters.
Because spiritual warfare doesn’t begin with your NO to Satan.
It begins with your YES to God.

sections.label: What If We’ve Been Starting With the Wrong Question?

items: A thought enters: “You deserve to be angry.”
We ask: “How do I stop being angry?”
Temptation appears: “You need this.”
We ask: “How do I resist this temptation?”
Those aren’t bad questions.
But perhaps there’s an earlier one:

blocks.text: Who am I submitting to right now?

items: The battle isn’t merely about removing an unwanted thought.
The battle is about allegiance.
Whose voice gets trusted?
Whose wisdom governs the next decision?
Who gets my YES?

sections.label: Christianity Cannot Become a Life Built Around “No”

items: If we aren’t careful, our entire spiritual life can become organized around everything we’re trying not to do.
But Paul says, “Walk by the Spirit.”
Walk.
Follow.
Keep in step.
Go somewhere.
The Christian life isn’t merely running away from sin.
It is walking with God.

sections.label: Resistance Without Relationship Will Exhaust You

items: Imagine standing in a dark room shouting, “Darkness, leave!”
You can spend enormous energy fighting darkness.
Or…. turn on the light.
Scripture absolutely commands resistance.
But biblical resistance is never meant to operate independently of relationship with God.
The strength of resistance flows from the position of submission.
If all of your attention is on what you’re resisting, what you’re resisting may still be controlling your attention.
The Christian life isn’t primarily built around what we are against.
It is built around Who we belong to.
Submit. Resist. Walk. Remain.
